info.title: SafeZone Identity API
info.description: Minimal identity read contract. Locality claims are filtering context and never an authorization grant.

get.summary: Return the authenticated actor's public-safe identity projection

display_name.description: Optional public-safe label; never an email, phone number, or legal identity record.

locality_scopes.description: Filtering context only. The server independently authorizes every operation; possession of a locality scope does not grant access.

IdentityProjection.description: Data-minimized projection. Authentication credentials, contact details, precise location, and household data are excluded.
